comment: Planner-level intents for the NPC Ruler AI (gdd-ruler-ai.md §5/§11; the four composite ids approved by Jedidiah 2026-06-28, plus withstand_siege — a §5.3 catalog action that existed in no activity JSON and must be registerable for the §9.2 vocabulary validation). The planner's other candidates (administer_domain, oversee_investment, issue_decree, train_troops, repress_population, call_to_arms, conscript_troops, levy_militia, hire_mercenaries) live in domain_category.json. Category 'ruler_ai' is planner-internal: no UI block lists these ids, so they never surface as player launchers (UI blocks hard-code their id lists).

activities.effect_summary: Composite: fund the garrison to the RAW 2gp/family universal minimum (+2 clanhold offset; wilderness targets 4gp/family per the base-morale threshold — PROJECT CALL) via conscripts then militia (tribal warriors for clanholds); if levy pools fall short, start the mercenary pipeline via solicit_mercenaries
activities.raw_citation: acore_axioms_strongholds_and_domains.xml §garrison L216-234 (2gp minimum; L233 wilderness 4gp base-morale threshold, borderlands 3gp customary — NOT enforced floors), §monthly_event_modifiers L486; ax_domains_of_chaos.xml L36 (clanhold blocks); ax_campaign_play.xml L689-704 (solicitation), L566 (hiring needs prior solicitation)
